description: Ranks the places in the atlas, worldwide or inside one country or one kind of place. The default order is fame rank, which comes from the most widely covered production shot there, so rank 1 is the place the most famous production used, not the place with the most credits. With `sort` set to `productions` the order is by number of productions (Los Angeles, New York, Vancouver).

category.description: Kind of place, as a key or a slug: studio (Studios & sets), castle (Castles & palaces), landmark (Landmarks & buildings), street (Streets & squares), nature (Landscapes & nature), city (Towns & cities), region (Countries & regions), fiction (Fictional places) (optional)

country.description: Country name or two letter ISO code (optional; without it the ranking is worldwide)

name: top_locations
title: The most filmed places
